_: portuguese-ids.json — the number in each Portuguese note's id, pinned to its note: <deck id> → <headword> (a sounds-deck row's key) → N, for the id u_<deck id>_N. A note of these decks is one note with two card templates, so both of a word's cards hang off this number. Seeded from the decks as shipped on 2026-11-16 and APPLIED by portuguese-fix.js: a rebuilt deck, which the generator numbers by position, is numbered back. NEVER delete or renumber a row — the Update press merges a reader's progress by id. A note a record removes moves to _retired; a new note takes the next free number; a rename renames the key.
